([[Solana Beach, California]]) | college = *[[Azusa Pacific Cougars men's basketball|Azusa Pacific]] (2021–2023) *[[UC San Diego Tritons men's basketball|UC San Diego]] (2023–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | career_start = 2025 | years1 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team1 = [[Maine Celtics]] | years2 = {{nbay|2025|end}} | team2 = [[Utah Jazz]] | highlights = * Second-team All-[[Big West Conference|Big West]] (2025) * Big West Defensive Player of the Year (2025) }} '''Hayden Gray''' (born May 11, 2003) is an American professional [[basketball]] player who last played for the [[Utah Jazz]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Azusa Pacific Cougars men's basketball|Azusa Pacific Cougars]] and [[UC San Diego Tritons men's basketball|UC San Diego Tritons]]. ==Early life== Gray was born on May 11, 2003.{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/player/1643060/hayden-gray|title=Hayden Gray {{!}} Guard {{!}} Utah Jazz|publisher=[[NBA.com]]|access-date=July 14, 2026}}{{ efn | Sources give conflicting birthplaces for Gray, with [[Basketball-Reference]] listing [[San Diego]] and his college bio from UC San Diego listing [[Napa Valley]]. }} He attended [[Santa Fe Christian School]] in [[Solana Beach, California]], where he starred on the basketball team. As a senior, Gray helped Santa Fe Christian to a [[California Interscholastic Federation]] (CIF) Division 1A state championship title. He also played for Gamepoint Basketball on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] (AAU) circuit.{{cite web|url=https://ucsdtritons.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/hayden-gray/13242|title=Hayden Gray - 2024-25 - Men's Basketball|publisher=[[UC San Diego Tritons]]|access-date=July 14, 2026}} ==College career== After beginning his college career at [[Azusa Pacific University]] in [[NCAA Division II|Division II]], Gray transferred to [[NCAA Division I|Division I]] [[UC San Diego]] where he played two seasons in 2023-24 and 2024-25.{{Cite web |title=Tritons Add Six Standouts to Roster |url=https://ucsdtritons.com/news/2023/7/13/mens-basketball-tritons-add-six-standouts-to-roster.aspx |access-date=2023-07-13 |website=UC San Diego |language=en}} Gray had a stellar senior season at UC San Diego, being named as a finalist for the 2025 Naismith Defensive Player of the Year, named to the 2025 Big West Championship All-Tournament Team and 2025 All-Big West Second Team while being named the 2025 Big West Defensive Player of the Year.{{cite web |title=2024-25 Men's Basketball All-Big West Teams and Award Winners Revealed |url=https://bigwest.org/news/2025/3/11/mens-basketball-2024-25-all-big-west-teams-and-award-winners-announced.aspx |website=The Big West |access-date=11 March 2025}} In 2025, Gray averaged 11.2 points, 3.1 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 3.1 steals, helping the Tritons to a school record 30-5 record and the program's first NCAA tournament appearance. The Tritons lost to [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] 68-65 in the first round of the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]]. He ended the season as the nation's leader in total steals.{{cite web |title=Hayden Gray College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/hayden-gray-1.html |website=Sports Reference CBB |access-date=11 April 2026}} ==Professional career== Gray joined the [[Boston Celtics]]' summer league team for the [[2025 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web |title=Boston Celtics reportedly add San Diego guard Hayden Gray to Las Vegas Summer League squad|url=https://celticswire.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/celtics/2025/07/06/celtics-reportedly-add-hayden-gray-to-las-vegas-summer-league-squad/84479064007/|website=Celtics Wire|access-date=June 29, 2025}} On July 20, 2025, it was reported that Gray had signed a contract with the [[Maine Celtics]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.celticsblog.com/2025/7/20/24471169/celtics-summer-league-hayden-gray-maine-celtics|title=Celtics Summer League guard signs with Maine Celtics [Exclusive]|first=Noa|last=Dalzell|date=July 21, 2025|website=CelticsBlog}} The next day, it was reported that Gray signed an [[Exhibit 10]] contract with the Boston.{{Cite web|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2025/07/hayden-gray-signs-exhibit-10-contract-with-celtics.html|title=Hayden Gray Signs Exhibit 10 Contract With Celtics|first1=Dana |last1=Gauruder|date=July 22, 2025|website=Hoops Rumors}} In November, Gray was officially named to the Maine Celtics opening night roster.{{Cite web|url=https://maine.gleague.nba.com/news/roster-announced-110625|title=Maine Celtics Announce Opening Night Roster|website=Maine Celtics}} On April 11, 2026, Gray signed a multi-year contract with the [[Utah Jazz]], and he made his NBA debut the next day.{{Cite web |date=2026-04-11 |title=Jazz's Hayden Gray: Inks deal with Utah |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/jazzs-hayden-gray-inks-deal-with-utah/ |access-date=2026-04-11 |website=CBS
